purpose: Assert that no alternative surpasses the named choice.
keywords: N + をおいて + … ない
No one but him is right for this role.
If we are to begin, there is no better chance than now.
I cannot imagine consulting anyone other than my teacher.
formation: N + をおいて + … ない
restrictions: Usually names the only suitable person, place, or time.
mistake: The negative conclusion is essential to the exclusivity.
